summary: This process describes how to map defined subjects to specific classes, streams, and sections. It also covers setting the subject type (General, Optional, Additional, Vocational) which influences how the subject is assigned to students.
steps: Click on "Add New Subject Class Mapping".
Select the "Class" (e.g., Class 5th). Multiple classes can be selected for common subjects.
The "Stream" and "Sections" will be selected by default; adjust if necessary.
Select the "Subject" from the dropdown list (e.g., English). The "Assessment Model" will auto-populate.
Select the "Subject Type" (e.g., General, Optional, Additional, Vocational).
Click "Add" to save the subject mapping for the selected class.
Repeat steps 4-7 to add more subjects to the same class mapping.
business_rules: "General" subjects are applied to all students in the mapped class.
"Optional", "Additional", or "Vocational" subjects are not automatically applied to all students and require separate assignment to specific students.
important_notes: You can map common subjects to multiple classes simultaneously.
The "Display Name" for a subject can be changed within the mapping, which is what students will see.
